name: When It Hits
source:
Ivanne speedruns his grieving process and complains about his life after hearing about the world ending in twenty minutes. 

[From [url=https://side-salt.itch.io/when-it-hits]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
得知世界将在二十分钟后毁灭，伊万飞快地走完哀伤的各个阶段，顺便抱怨起自己的人生。

[摘自[url=https://side-salt.itch.io/when-it-hits]Itch.io[/url]]
